name: Egis Technology Inc.
summary: Egis Technology Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the IC design, research, development, and sales of data security protection software, and biometric identification software and hardware in the United States, Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers lens type fingerprint sensor technology; U2F solution; mobile authentication; standard cell library; memory compilers; I/O library; UCIE-A PHY and controller; UCIE-S PHY and controller; and IPTD2D-A PHY and controller; foundation IP; ONFI; DDR; MIPI; automotive IP suite; display interface; ADC; and other IPs.
